description: NaBa₂Sr₂(SbO₄)₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmce space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SbO₆ octahedra and faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-12°. There are two shorter (2.25 Å) and four longer (2.28 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ba is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with six SbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.73-3.15 Å. Sr is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to twelve O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.61-3.26 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four SbO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-20°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.10 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-12°. There are two shorter (1.91 Å) and four longer (2.10 Å) Sb-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ba, two equivalent Sr, and two equivalent Sb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, two equivalent Sr, and one Sb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, two equivalent Sr, and one Sb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ba, two equivalent Sr, and two Sb atoms.
